flows.about: Story DT308.4 to DT308.6 (0.3.157, board Stories237; Coach Milan, Go 18 November 11:14): the end of a read with no meal set. A photo is read and no meal is guessed: the line says No meal selected, and the read ends with What do you do with it? Save it, Plan it, Ate it, all three white. Ate it on a photo taken now opens your calendar under the button on today, with the guess from the clock marked and its reason. On an older photo it opens on the photo's day with the guess from the photo's time marked (this solves B147: the photo's day, not today's clock). A tap on a meal sets it in the line, and the read goes on as before: Did you eat it? All of it, Half, Part of it, then Done. Plan it opens the calendar on tomorrow with nothing marked; the tap plans it and you land on Plan on that day, with no Did you eat it?. Save it keeps it in My recipes with its photo; the plate stays and the button says Saved in My recipes. The checks name the rows of the build brief (C1 to C6).
